paragraphs: Ben Hammedori, see there, in Shmuel’s name, Shabbat 125, beginning of a; Middot 35b [locator retained]; Menachot 38b. “I stood before Shmuel,” Yoma 87b. Rava: “Bar Hammedori explained it,” Shabbat 107, end of b;125, beginning of a, Rashi: he explained the reason; Yevamot 83b; see Yevamot 1. Could he live from Shmuel to Rava? Arukh explains “warming boilers” [מיחם דודי; lexical attachment unresolved].
